artworks.title: Kneeling Angel
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a kneeling position, with the upper body leaning forward and arms extended in front with palms facing up. The facial features are not detailed, and the person has a short hairstyle. They are wearing a loose-fitting garment, and there are no visible details of jewelry or objects. The background is plain with faint marks and discoloration typical of old paper. The focus is on the form and posture of the figure without additional context or scenery elements.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint  Angelus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ann Sutherland Harris in honor of Elizabeth Cropper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a central figure surrounded by cherubs. The central figure is standing on a cloud and the cherubs have wings and rounded faces. They are in various poses, creating a dynamic composition. The scene has minimalistic atmospheric details, emphasizing the figures and their arrangement.

artworks.title: Standing Soldier, Facing Right
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of red chalk on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image shows a person in armor standing in a side profile. They hold a spear over their shoulder, with their head turned slightly away from the viewer. The person wears a helmet with a crest and detailed armor covering the upper body and arms. Their legs are less detailed, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl seated on a chair, dressed in a white lace dress with pink bows on her shoulders. She has dark wavy hair, holds a bouquet of colorful flowers, and sits beside a basket of flowers on a wooden stool. The background is a soft blend of colors.

artworks.title: Alfred Tennyson with his Sons
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three people from the waist up. The central figure is a seated older man with a beard and long, wavy hair. He is wearing a dark coat over a white shirt with a dark tie. On either side of him are two younger individuals with long, wavy hair. The person on the right appears to have curly hair and is wearing a dark coat with large, white buttons and a large white collar. The person on the left has similar attire, also featuring a white collar. Both are standing slightly behind the seated man. They are positioned closely together. The background is dark and plain.

artworks.title: Milton's Dream of His Deceased Wife
artworks.medium: etching on Chinese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in bed, covered by a blanket. They are lying on their side with one hand under their head and the other on their face. The person has medium-length tousled hair and a partially visible face turned towards the viewer. The bed is next to a window, with a small table holding an open book and a lamp. A window in the background reveals a cross against the moonlit night sky. The room is dimly lit.

artworks.title: The Perniciousness of Men
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Marten de Vos
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered around a table with food and musical instruments under a vine-covered structure. The scene depicts a feast in grayscale, with various shades of black, white, and gray. Multiple figures sit and recline around a table in the foreground, while another figure serves food. In the background, there is a palace-like structure with towers on the left, and on the right, a landscape with trees, a small village, and a distant horizon. A tall palm tree is on the terrace where the gathering is happening.

artworks.title: Mare (The Sea)
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Dirck Barendsz
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded, muscular man riding a horse-like creature emerging from the waves. The man is nude and holding a large trident. The creature has equine features with a strong neck and flipper-like hooves. The background shows rough waves under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Henoch and His Family at a Meal
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Marten de Vos
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a pastoral scene with a pond, ducks, a family outside a thatched-roof building, figures and animals on a bridge, dense trees, fields, and a sky with clouds. The etching uses intricate strokes to depict texture and depth in the foliage and architecture.

artworks.title: The Offering of Cain and Abel
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I after Michael de Coxcij
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two muscular, bearded men from the waist up, kneeling on one knee on opposite sides. The man on the left has shoulder-length curly hair and crossed arms in front of a stack of smoldering offerings. The man on the right has short curly hair, raising his arms towards the sky, near another stack of offerings emitting smoke and a group of sheep. Both men are unclothed in a natural setting with a large tree, distant hills, a sky with clouds, and rays of light highlighting the scene.

artworks.title: Cain Killing Abel
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Michael de Coxcij
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 20.5 × 27.6 cm (8 1/16 × 10 7/8 in.)
sheet: 21 × 27.8 cm (8 1/4 × 10 15/16 in.), trimmed within platemark on left
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals struggling in a pastoral landscape. One figure is poised over another, clutching a bone with intent. The background shows rolling hills, trees, and billowing smoke from a rock formation, where what seems to be livestock is gathered. The cross-hatching and line work create depth and texture, while the poses of the figures add a dynamic energy to the composition.

artworks.title: Terra (Earth)
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Dirck Barendsz
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure representing the Earth. The central focus is a robed figure holding a scepter and appearing contemplative. This figure is crowned with small fortifications. The background features mountainous terrain, a distant cityscape, and figures engaged in laborious activities such as mining or digging in a cave. A leafless tree stands to the left, and a tree with sparse leaves rises to the right. The drawing style is intricate, with detailed shading and line work. The text above the figure reads "TERRA."

artworks.title: Hunting Trophy with Mallard, Partridge, Goldfinches, and Onions
artworks.medium: pastel on prepared canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of birds tied together against a neutral background. The main bird is a duck with a green head and orange feet. Other birds in the cluster include a woodpecker with pink hues and a group of small, reddish onions. The color palette consists of brown, cream, dark greens, and pink. The arrangement is positioned in the upper central portion with a tilt to the right, and shadows suggest a light source from the left.

artworks.title: Hunting Trophy with Hare and Bay Leaves
artworks.medium: pastel on prepared canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a hare hanging upside down with green leaves around it. The hare has soft brown, white, and red fur. It is fixed by its hind legs and its head points downward, with its body slightly angled to the right.

artworks.title: Autumn Landscape in the Forest of Fontainebleau
artworks.medium: watercolor with graphite
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin

artworks.title: Study of a Male Nude
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor with white gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dian Woodner

artworks.title: A Wooded Path at Treslong, near Hillegom
artworks.medium: black chalk and watercolor on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dirt path winding into the distance under a lush green tree canopy. The horizon is low in the composition where the path disappears beyond a distant bridge, adding depth. The brushstrokes give a textured effect, enhancing the depiction of foliage. The dominant color is green, with hints of earth tones from the path and flecks of blue from the sky. A figure in a red coat and black hat leans against a tree on the right.

artworks.title: Navigation (Allegory of the Navy)
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with graphite on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated male figure holding an oar and a rope in a boat. He is muscular with distinct facial features, short tousled hair, and is minimally clothed. In the background is a sail and the word "NAVIGATION."

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of Hoche
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene. A figure with a halo is depicted descending from the sky, holding a ladder. The figure is surrounded by clouds and fantastical creatures. Above them, a triangle symbol is enclosed in light, framed by pillars, with smaller figures around it. Below, there is a dramatic landscape showing buildings and a fiery scene with skeletal horse-like figures. The details suggest a narrative of cosmic importance, typical of allegorical or symbolic art from the Baroque or Romantic period.

artworks.title: Acanthus Ornament
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays flowing lines and shapes creating an intricate design, conveying movement. It is an abstract depiction resembling a stylized wave or wood scroll, with detailed leaf-like patterns adding a natural element. On the left, clusters of textured shapes resembling grapes and foliage enhance the natural connection.

artworks.title: A Soldier in Ancient Roman Costume with Pike and Shield
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache, over black chalk, on blue laid paper, squared in black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Roman warrior in armor. The drawing shows a figure holding a spear in one hand and a shield in the other. The shield features a fierce-looking face. The armor is detailed with patterns, including a muscular torso plate and greaves. The warrior's helmet has a plume. The use of shading and highlights in the drawing enhances the three-dimensionality of the figure.

artworks.title: Malinconia (Melancholy, or Head of a Woman)
artworks.medium: monotype etching printed in color on parchment
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 21.2 × 14.4 cm (8 3/8 × 5 11/16 in.)
sheet ( irregular and cut within platemark on sides): 29.2 × 14.4 cm (11 1/2 × 5 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the upper shoulders up. The individual has their head slightly tilted to the right and their eyes closed or looking down. The facial features are soft and slightly blurred, focusing on the eyes, nose, and lips. The hair is short and indistinct, blending with the background. The person is not wearing prominent clothing. The background consists of muted earthy tones blending with the subject's image. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape beside a River
artworks.medium: graphite and white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees on either side. Beyond the trees, there is a horizon with faint silhouetted trees further back. The pencil strokes show detailed textures and lines defining the foliage and landscape. The color palette consists of gray tones, creating a calm atmosphere. A person stands near the trees, and a body of water curves through the scene leading to the horizon. The sky in the background has soft clouds.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body at the center with long, curly hair, a crown of thorns, neutral expression, a beard, and draped in a cloth. Three other figures surround him, one wearing a detailed helmet with a plume to the left, a bearded man with a turban-like head covering to the right, and another figure gesturing towards the center. In the lower right, a woman is depicted holding a cloth to her face. The scene is set against a simple architectural backdrop with vertical elements like columns or a doorway. The artwork is monochrome with detailed line work and shading.
